**Enum** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public enum PrinterState
```

Enumerates the states a printer can report.

## Values

- **`Unknown`** (`0`): The print system did not report a state, or reported one Latiprimere does not recognise.
- **`Idle`** (`1`): The printer is ready and has no jobs in progress.
- **`Processing`** (`2`): The printer is processing one or more jobs.
- **`Stopped`** (`3`): The printer is stopped and needs attention, for example because it is paused, offline or out of paper.
